release_notes:
New Features
- Expandable food item cards with detailed nutrition info
- Interactive "Add to Compare" button in expanded cards
- Radar chart for nutrition comparison
- Faster app launch (removed default splash screen)

Improvements
- Enhanced UI responsiveness
- Better nutrition data visualization
- Improved layout across different screen sizes
- Smoother animations and transitions

Bug Fixes
- Fixed layout issues on various devices
- Improved error handling
- Enhanced overall stability
